body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{band}}\), the continuous versions selected by the H\"older restrictions satisfy \[\tau_P(x_0)=\mu_{1,P}(x_0)-\mu_{0,P}(x_0)=\mathbb{E}_P[Y(1)-Y(0)\mid X=x_0].\]
body.justification: The point target must be a version-invariant causal law functional before its risk can be studied.
body.gap: Kennedy et al. work with the same continuous H\"older CATE; this lemma makes the version choice explicit for the positive-band class.
body.consumer: Every branch risk bound and the final minimax comparison use this identified point target.
